sources.name: Census TIGER/Line boundaries — California (places, tracts, county subdivisions, counties)

sources.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer — flood zones
sources.license: US public (FEMA)

T1.1 price/value.source: county deed/transfer records + FHFA HPI + Zillow ZHVI; datasf_assessor_rolls acquired but Prop-13-capped (NOT market price)

T1.3 crime/safety.source: datasf_crime (SF); other metros need each city's open data

T1.6 walk/bike/transit score.source: recomputed from osm_california + gtfs; do NOT buy Walk Score

T2.2 wildfire/WUI.source: calfire_fhsz (2011 vintage; current 2024/25 = gap); USFS WUI planned

T2.6 utilities septic/well/gas.source: per-county health/utility GIS; not yet sourced

T2.9 short-term rental rules.source: municipal code, hard to parse; insideairbnb gives ACTIVITY not the rules

T3.2 road/traffic noise.source: model from DOT AADT + FHWA TNM (inputs planned)

T3.5 industrial/landfill/TRI.source: epa_tri_ca (5.1k CA toxic-release facilities w/ coords); FRS for landfill/wastewater still available if needed

T3.6 tree canopy.source: datasf_street_trees city inventory (198k); NLCD canopy-% raster remains catalog for continuous cover

T3.7 elevation/slope/view.source: USGS 3DEP (TNM API / S3, bbox on demand)

T3.11 siren corridors.source: derive from fire-station / facility locations (HIFLD, federal agent)

T4.4 grocery/pharmacy access.source: overture_places + fsq_os_places (2 POI witnesses, SF bbox)

T4.5 urgent care/ER.source: HIFLD redundant w/ Overture POIs; use overture_places hospital category, or HIFLD for bed/trauma metadata

T4.8 airport access.source: routing to airport POIs (osm); no dataset

T6.1 approved construction/view-light.source: datasf_permits + datasf_dev_pipeline (1.9k projects, net units); view/light loss also needs 3DEP terrain (catalog)

T6.2 school boundary changes.source: board agendas (unstructured); datasf_sfusd_boundaries gives the snapshot, diffing annual snapshots catches changes but not the proposal process

T6.4 approved transit.source: datasf_sfmta_projects (98 project polygons); regional capital plans still manual

T6.7 large entitlements (CEQA/EIR).source: CEQAnet (CA OPR/LCI) -- NO api/bulk exists; scrape sitemap->SCH record pages (Firecrawl)

T6.9 CIP + passed bond measures.source: city budget/capital-plan docs (unstructured PDFs); needs extraction
